scientific_integrity: Proof is self-contained; the finite checker tests cases through six points only. No independent expert or formal certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The formulas concern square-zero partial injections only, counting rank but not nilpotency index. The 2020 finite-centralizer paper and Lipscomb monograph were not fully read; historical priority of the nilpotent-rank polynomial is provisional.
title: Nilpotent rank distributions in square-zero symmetric inverse monoid centralizers
